spec.rawSql:
WITH base_stats AS (
    SELECT
        $__timeGroup(event_time, $__interval, 0) AS time,
        hostname,
        domain_root,
        COUNT(*)::double precision AS cnt,
        SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(visit_duration, 0), 1))::double precision AS dur
    FROM raw.browser
    WHERE
        $__timeFilter(event_time)
        AND hostname IS NOT NULL
        AND hostname != ''
        AND domain_root IS NOT NULL 
        AND domain_root != ''
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
probs AS (
    SELECT
        time,
        hostname,
        domain_root,
        cnt,
        dur,
        cnt / NULLIF(SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY time, hostname), 0) AS p_cnt,
        dur / NULLIF(SUM(dur) OVER (PARTITION BY time, hostname), 0) AS p_dur
    FROM base_stats
)
SELECT
    time,
    hostname,
    -- 1. 回数ベース シャノンエントロピー (bits)
    COALESCE(-SUM(CASE WHEN p_cnt > 0 THEN p_cnt * (ln(p_cnt) / ln(2.0)) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "Count Entropy (bits)",

    -- 2. 滞在時間ベース シャノンエントロピー (bits)
    COALESCE(-SUM(CASE WHEN p_dur > 0 THEN p_dur * (ln(p_dur) / ln(2.0)) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "Duration Entropy (bits)",

    -- 3. 正規化エントロピー (回数ベース: 0.0〜1.0)
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN COALESCE(-SUM(CASE WHEN p_cnt > 0 THEN p_cnt * (ln(p_cnt) / ln(2.0)) ELSE 0 END) / (ln(COUNT(*)::double precision) / ln(2.0)), 0)
        ELSE 0 
    END AS "Normalized Count Entropy (0-1)",

    -- 4. 正規化エントロピー (滞在時間ベース: 0.0〜1.0)
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN COALESCE(-SUM(CASE WHEN p_dur > 0 THEN p_dur * (ln(p_dur) / ln(2.0)) ELSE 0 END) / (ln(COUNT(*)::double precision) / ln(2.0)), 0)
        ELSE 0 
    END AS "Normalized Duration Entropy (0-1)",

    -- 5. ユニークドメイン数 (参考)
    COUNT(domain_root) AS "Unique Domains",

    -- 6. 総閲覧回数 (参考)
    SUM(cnt) AS "Total Pageviews"
FROM probs
GROUP BY time, hostname
ORDER BY time, hostname;
